Dirwai 4 & Kaveh Madani 3 Nature Water ( 2026 ) Cite this article Save article View saved research As water insecurity intensifies worldwide, Africa’s experience offers important insights for navigating uncertainty. From shared-river governance to climate adaptation and the integration of scientific and local knowledge, the continent provides lessons that are increasingly relevant far beyond its borders.
